purpose: Teach: 後遺症/火葬/引き起こさ/漏らし/退去/服従/脱退/揶揄

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の労災後遺症対応を充実させろ
lines.en: I want us to expand our support for employees dealing with work-related injuries and their aftermath.
lines.style: Command delivered with measured authority. Clipped opening attack on 「当社」. Steady pace—no rush, no uncertainty. Voice carries the weight of instruction without aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。火葬場関連事業への参入も検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring entry into the cremation services sector.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive report. Slight forward lean in the posture. Crisp articulation on each point. Professional pace—neither rushed nor hesitant. Demonstrates he's been paying close attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合に動揺を引き起こさせる新製品を出せ
lines.en: Release a new product that will shake our competitors.
lines.style: Direct, unflinching instruction. Slight emphasis on the verb. No hedging. Steady eye-level delivery. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed without explanation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。機密を漏らした社員には厳罰で対応します
lines.en: Yes. We'll take strict disciplinary action against any employee who leaks confidential information.
lines.style: Formal confirmation. Slight steel beneath the politeness—he's assuring his boss that loose ends are handled. Even pace, controlled breath. Demonstrates competence without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、悪質取引先からの退去を急げ
lines.en: Move quickly to sever ties with any partners who've acted unethically.
lines.style: Command with underlying principle. Clipped emphasis on 「急げ」. Composed authority—this isn't emotional, it's strategic. Tone suggests pragmatism tempered by standards.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。絶対服従ではなく対話の社風を作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll foster a company culture built on dialogue rather than blind obedience.
lines.style: Thoughtful affirmation. Slight warmth enters here—he's signaling alignment with something deeper than orders. Deliberate pacing on key phrase. Shows he's not just following directives but understanding the philosophy behind them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界団体から脱退する選択肢も持て
lines.en: Keep the option of withdrawing from industry associations on the table.
lines.style: Strategic instruction. Opens with precision on 「当社」. Slightly slower tempo—this is a significant decision, delivered without drama. The authority that considers multiple moves ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品を揶揄するレビューにも誠実に対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to even critical reviews of our products with integrity and transparency.
lines.style: Final confirmation, elevated in tone. Emphasis shifts to 「誠実に」—this is the closing principle. Steady breath, professional but not stiff. Leaves a resonance of commitment.
